name: Hayatsuki Masaki
source:
Lieutenant of Kuzuryuu group.

Originally working as a programmer, after some dramatic events he joined Kuzuryuu group. Calm and polite, he quickly achieved the position of lieutenant. He provides Kotaro with intel and logistic support during missions.
